learning_outcomes.text: Make inferences from a text, to evaluate and react to the ideas in a reading text
Write a documented argumentative essay by using citation techniques in APA style
Listen effectively and take notes during a lecture or seminar, etc.

syllabus_topics: INTRODUCTORY UNIT RESEARCH SKILLS: Evaluating sources for relevance and reliability, Identifying reference information, Researching on the Internet, Researching in the Library, Identifying and selecting relevant sources
LISTENING: While-listening 1: Street Survey on the Concept of Power, While-listening 2: Research Findings on the Concept of Power
SPEAKING: Task 1: Expressing opinions on power related statements, Task 2: Reporting of research findings on power related issues
UNIT 1 READING: Reading Text: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk- A Commander and an Effective Leader
WRITING: Using the target vocabulary learned so far in writing, Writing a reaction paragraph, Writing parts of a documented essay, Citation and borrowing ideas
LISTENING: While-listening 1: Student Presentations on Leadership Types
SPEAKING: Task 1: Debate on leadership, Task 2: Mini presentation about an effective leader
UNIT 2 READING: Reading Text: The Changing Face of Power
WRITING: Using the target vocabulary learned so far in writing, Writing a reaction paragraph, Synthesizing
LISTENING: While-listening 1: Psychological Warfare, Listening and note-taking 1: Psychological Warfare, Listening and note-taking 2: Oppression
SPEAKING: Task 1: Debate on hard and soft power, Task 2: Mini presentation on a country's politics
MIDTERM
UNIT 3 READING: Reading Text: The Media: Voices of the Powerful

WRITING: The Argumentative Essay, Writing the argumentative thesis statement, Identifying the difference between the expository and argumentative thesis statement, Preparing the pro- con chart, Refuting the counterarguments, Outlining, Maintaining unity and coherence, Avoiding logical fallacies, Writing parts of an argumentative essay
LISTENING: While-listening: Interview on Media Literacy

SPEAKING: Task 1: Impromptu speech on the concept of media, Task 2: Mini presentation about a current event reported by different sources, Task 3: Team presentation on the comparison and contrast of different TV channels, Task 4: Devil's advocate
UNIT 4 READING: Reading Text: It is a Rich Man's World
WRITING: The Reaction-Response Essay
LISTENING: While-listening: Around the Track, Listening and note-taking: Interviews on Globalization
SPEAKING: Task 1: Reaction to an idea, Task 2: Role play on gold-mining, Task 3: Impromptu speech on the concept of globalization
bibliography: Academic English II (Lecture Notes) by Can Gür
The Compass - Route to Academic English 2 - Nüans Publishing Gonca Gülen, Burçin Hasanbaşoğlu, Elif Şeşen, Gökçe Tokdemir
